identity_master.prompt_summary: AS59 female Quyền Tu master V2: braided chestnut bun, warm hazel eyes, fully covered charcoal wrap tunic with copper-red sash and forearm wraps; unarmed guard pose, transparent background. AS59 V1 retained separately as NOT SELECTED.

animation_sheet_rules: 4 columns x 6 rows; each row is Idle, Walk, Attack, Cast, Hit, Downed; four visibly distinct adjacent full-body pose cels; direction genuinely redrawn, no flip; no held weapons or VFX; transparent background; fixed master identity.
